name: Al Kurin
slug: Vessels containing the souls of dragons
description: Al Kurin are vessels capable of containing the soul of a dragon.

log.summary: During this session, it was noted that Grixto had been collecting Al Kurin from other trainees at the training grounds, including juvenile dragons. Al Kurin can be transported away from the location where they were collected.

log.summary: Al Kurin are described as a dragon’s heart of hearts. Grixto took them from guild companions he killed at the training grounds and used them to amplify his power. In Emhet’s vision he sat with a couple of Al Kurin while plotting his next steps.

log.summary: Carlkin treats Grixto's dragon-killing as theft of Al Kurin and immediately asks where Walker and his dragon are. Elrus says Walker's theory, that Grixto became a lich after Galixtar's death, would explain his eagerness to obtain the Al Kurin.
